description:
About the Position

The Department of Earth Sciences at Uppsala University invites applications for a PhD student position in geophysics. Uppsala operates one of the longest-running geoscience programmes in Europe, and its geophysics activities span solid-Earth geophysics, geophysical imaging of subsurface structure, and studies of crustal processes combining seismic, potential-field and electromagnetic methods with quantitative modelling. The doctoral position is a salaried appointment under the Swedish collective agreement, with the standard four-year employment structure and full social benefits.

Doctoral students in the department work within active research groups, participate in field campaigns, and contribute to the department's teaching in later stages of the programme. The position suits a candidate with a strong quantitative background who wants to work at the interface of physical measurement and geological interpretation. Uppsala's Earth sciences environment includes shared instrument parks, national infrastructure access and collaboration partners across the Nordic geoscience community.

Candidate Profile

Applicants hold a master's degree (or equivalent) in geophysics, physics, geology or a related quantitative field, and demonstrate solid skills in mathematics, programming and data analysis. Experience with geophysical field methods or numerical modelling is an advantage. Admission is assessed on academic record, research potential and fit with the supervisory group, and applications are submitted through Uppsala University's Varbi recruitment system with CV, transcripts, references and a statement of research interests.

Highlights

  • Salaried four-year PhD employment in geophysics
  • Department of Earth Sciences, Uppsala University
  • Seismic, potential-field and electromagnetic methods
  • Field campaigns and quantitative modelling
  • Nordic geoscience collaboration and instrument access
  • Application via the Varbi recruitment system
